- TOTAL revenue reached £16,740.23 TW versus £5,757.32 LW, a WoW gain of 190.8%.
- TOTAL units came in at 15,031 TW against 2,024 LW, up 642.6% WoW, while TOTAL orders rose from 135 LW to 166 TW, up 23.0% WoW.
- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER ranked 1 TW with £3,388.78, a 20.2% share of TW revenue, and led on orders with 62 TW.
- WOODEN SKITTLES GARDEN SET ranked 2 TW with £2,650.90 and a 15.8% TW revenue share.
- PACK OF 12 SUKI TISSUES ranked 3 TW with £2,573.71 and a 15.4% TW share, and posted the largest absolute WoW gain at £2,531.08.
- The top 3 products together accounted for 51.5% of TOTAL revenue TW.
- PACK OF 12 HEARTS DESIGN TISSUES recorded the largest percentage WoW increase at 6,087.6%.
- PARTY BUNTING showed the largest WoW decline at 12.4%, equal to a drop of £233.64 versus LW.
- PACK OF 12 SUKI TISSUES was the top unit seller TW at 5,247 units.
